_comment: 亡灵契约 IV (Necromancy IV PROVISIONAL).
The level, the price and the cooldown of this node are DEV VALUES: the user has not decided the real ones yet, and
these three numbers exist only so that the whole chain - buy it, press the key, wake a bone dragon - can be tested.
They are deliberately the cheapest possible (level 1, no souls) so that no other node has to be bought first, and
they are expected to change before this skill is released.
